<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/transfer_configurations/preview"}
#docs
No writes. Returns, for each pair (the test twins first when `include_test_twins` is set), every field the run would change from → to, the tax plan line by line, and the `blockers` that would refuse the run. Secrets show as `••••`. A live destination is planned as if the live override were granted; its override sections have status `needs_live_override`. Send `plan_digest` back in `live_override` to bind a run to this preview.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `destination_business` | `string` | **yes** | The id of the business to copy the configuration to (biz_…). |
| `sections` | `array of string` | no | The sections to copy. Omitted: catalog, coupons, tax_rates and settings. |
| `wipe_destination` | `boolean` | no | True to clear the destination's existing configuration first. Test destinations only. |
| `numbering` | `object` | no | Prefixes to set on the destination. Omitted: the destination keeps its own. A prefix that another business uses, or that numbers already issued start with, is refused. |
| `numbering.invoice_prefix` | `string` | no | The destination's new invoice prefix. |
| `numbering.credit_note_prefix` | `string` | no | The destination's new credit note prefix. |
| `include_test_twins` | `boolean` | no | Both businesses live: also copy the source's test business into the destination's test business, first. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `transfer_preview`. One of `transfer_preview`. |
| `source_business` | `string` | The source business (biz_…). |
| `destination_business` | `string` | The destination business (biz_…). |
| `sections` | `array of string` | The sections planned. |
| `plan_digest` | `string` | Binds a live-override run to this preview. Changes when the destination changes. |
| `live_override_available` | `boolean` | The destination is live and the live override would change something. |
| `pairs` | `array of object` | One plan per pair: the test twins first, then the main pair. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The transfer preview |
| `400` | Invalid body, or test twins asked for without two live businesses |
| `403` | Requires an all-mode API key and the admin permission |
| `404` | No such destination business |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/transfer_configurations/preview" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "destination_business": "biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01"
  }'
```
